book_title: Building Agentic AI Systems: From First Agent to MCP, Multi-Agent Orchestration, and Production
author: Srinivasa Rao Bittla

offline_test_status.model: scripted stand-in (solutions/tests/fakemodel.py); no API key, no model provider called

model_test_status.evidence: solutions/outputs/*/summary.json (each records its own commit and lock hash)

known_limitations: The deterministic suite was run outside the course image; 13 tests that need the image's MCP servers were skipped. CI reruns the suite inside the image when a book-v* tag is pushed.
2 model-dependent exercises have no recorded live-model run yet: M.3, 31.5. Record them with ./course.sh run-chapter <ids> --model claude.
Live-model runs were recorded on earlier commits than the verified one; each summary.json names its own commit.

Two runtime images are not pinned: ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server:latest (exercises 14.3, 14.4, Capstone 4) and ollama/ollama:latest (the free local model). See VERSION_MATRIX.md for the fallback and how to pin them.
Production readiness is not claimed: the course kit is not production-hardened (Appendix M of the book, SECURITY_MODEL.md).
open_gates: Run the deterministic suite inside the course image (CI does this on a book-v* tag) and record it with python dev/verify.py report.

Independent technical review and a beginner-reader pilot (PILOT.md), with findings recorded.

commit_note: git_commit is the commit the tests ran on. The release tag may sit on a later commit that adds only verification artifacts and docs; release_manifest.py --check fails if any code, solution, test or environment file changed in between.
